rubric.statement: `model_list` is treated as unsafe serialized LM state, alongside endpoint override keys, rather than as ordinary safe LM configuration.
`Predict.load_state()` defaults to sanitizing the saved LM state before reconstructing `dspy.LM`, so unsafe keys such as `model_list` are removed unless explicitly allowed.

When a checkpoint containing `lm.model_list` is loaded without opting in, the restored LM no longer carries `model_list` and execution falls back to the normal single-model completion path instead of deployment-list routing.

If loading is done with `allow_unsafe_lm_state=True`, DSPy preserves the serialized `model_list`, and LiteLLM receives the deployment list with nested per-deployment overrides such as the saved `api_base`.
